name: Wasantha Kumara
headline: CEO & Founder | Kaizens Group | Driving Innovation Through AI-Powered IFS Delivery
about:
I am an IFS transformation leader with over 26 years of experience in the IFS ecosystem, focused on driving innovation, growth, and AI-powered improvements in how ERP implementations and upgrades are delivered.

I am the CEO & Founder of Kaizens Group, where we deliver end-to-end IFS implementations and upgrades while using AI-powered automation and tooling to accelerate delivery and reduce risk. We help organisations turn complex ERP programmes into structured, value-driven IFS Cloud journeys—from strategy and execution through to go-live and stabilisation.

My background spans deep, hands-on IFS delivery, including implementations, upgrades, data migration, testing, reporting, integrations, security, and release readiness. Having worked across multiple large-scale IFS programmes, I’ve seen firsthand where traditional ERP projects struggle—heavy manual effort, late risk discovery, and avoidable rework.

That experience is what drives how we innovate at Kaizens. We combine strong programme delivery and functional expertise with deep IFS technical capability and an AI-powered automation toolset to deliver faster, safer, and more predictable outcomes. Our KAIBRIDGE tools are built from real delivery experience and are used directly in the IFS projects we deliver to accelerate upgrades and migrations, automate testing and reporting, and reduce delivery risk at scale.

I also lead the Kaizens AI Lab, which focuses on practical, enterprise-grade innovation—applying AI selectively to areas such as data mapping, data cleansing, planning, and preparation. Our approach ensures AI accelerates delivery while governance, accountability, and decision-making remain firmly with delivery teams and customers.

What matters most to me is measurable impact: time saved, risk reduced, quality improved—and leaving customers, partners, and teams stronger at the end of every engagement.

Areas of Focus

IFS Cloud • End-to-End IFS Implementations & Upgrades • ERP Transformation • Innovation • Enterprise AI • Automation • Data Migration • Test Automation • Reporting Modernisation • Product Engineering • Leadership
